name: 59-three-part-request
prompt: Three things: add a /healthz route to Handler returning 200 with the body 'ok'; add a doc comment above Handler saying what routes it serves; and add a file s/README.md listing the routes. The package must build.
check: grep -q 'healthz' s/server.go && grep -q 'ok' s/server.go && test -f s/README.md && grep -q 'healthz' s/README.md && go build ./...
